target.statement: InsCL achieves an average Relative Gain of 93.71 on 16 tasks with three training orders, compared to 92.01 for Random Replay.

compute.basis: Requires full fine-tuning of LLaMA-7B on 16 tasks (total ~2.8M examples) for 2 epochs each, repeated for 3 training orders and multiple methods, which is infeasible on a CPU-only laptop within hours.

blockers: Requires full fine-tuning of LLaMA-7B, which needs significant GPU memory (e.g., multiple A100s).
Training on 16 tasks with 2 epochs each and multiple methods is extremely time-consuming.
No code or configuration files are provided, so the entire pipeline must be reimplemented from scratch.
title: InsCL: A Data-efficient Continual Learning Paradigm for Fine-tuning Large Language Models with Instructions
